verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt file served at docs.livekit.io/llms.txt. LiveKit also documents agent-oriented docs: a Docs MCP server that installs into IDEs or coding agents, and a 'skills, docs, and tools' offering that makes coding agents LiveKit experts. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of how well agents use these docs, and evidence on the depth and completeness of the llms.txt content (the root /.md probe returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.livekit.io/llms.txt # LiveKit docs
